scraped.title: European Statistical Training Programme Lot 3
scraped.subtitle: European Statistical Training Programme (ESTP III): Modernisation of ESS Business Architecture (Lot 3)
scraped.description: This European Statistical Training Programme – Phase III aims at maintaining a high level of competence and ensuring that quality is consistent throughout the European Statistical System (ESS). The courses provide statisticians of the ESS with continuous training in new…
body: This European Statistical Training Programme – Phase III aims at maintaining a high level of competence and ensuring that quality is consistent throughout the European Statistical System (ESS). The courses provide statisticians of the ESS with continuous training in new methods, techniques and best practices related to the statistical subject fields and integrate the application of European concepts and definitions. This project is implemented in close cooperation with trainers from 18 EU National Statistical Institutes, who guarantee the European dimension of the programme and enhance the exchange of best practices.

ICON-INSTITUT is supporting at raising the overall quality of European statistics and qualification of statisticians in order to promote their independence. Furthermore, encouraging both theoretical and practical training and the exchange of best practices and experience.

ICON provides the organisation and implementation of a training activity Lot 3 “Modernisation of ESS Business Architecture”, that includes services such as capacity building, design of the training programme including training material, delivery of trainings, curriculum development, quality assurance, project monitoring and evaluation and reporting.
